**Before downloading**

1. Apply for (paid) access at https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk; download field 20205.
2. Download all files into one folder, keeping the provider's folder structure.

```bash
biosignal-data import ukbiobank/ecg <folder you downloaded into> --version <label> --dest s3://<bucket>
```
